events.title: Pisgah Rage Pre-season
events.description: Pre-season activities including social events, rider assessment, bike shop night, parent meeting, and adventure rides in Bent Creek or Dupont

events.title: Pisgah Rage Regular Season
events.description: Regular season with indoor training in January, weekend practices in February, and 2 rides per week March-May. Races start beginning of March with 5-6 races across North Carolina through end of May. Racing typically occurs on Sundays with Saturday pre-rides.
